title: Anatomy of a Run
summary: A user prompt starts the run. The agent receives it, loads the shared Skill, drafts a plan, and discovers its MCP tools. Execution is a loop — decide, call a tool, observe, append to context — one turn per lap, growing the context each time, with every tools/call served by the same shared MCP server. After the final turn the grown context is summarized into an answer that returns to the user.

steps.caption: A user prompt starts the run.
The agent receives it with its environment: system prompt, guardrails, model.
It loads the shared Skill — the current version, read-only and metered.
It discovers the MCP tools it will need (tools/list).
Execution is a loop: decide, call a tool on the same MCP server, observe, append — the context grows every turn.
After the final turn the whole context is distilled into an answer, which returns to the user; the session is saved for replay.
